findings.message: Report shell should use a research-note layout with summary table and figure grid.
Report must not use chatbot-style labels or question-style framing.
HTML must not expose local filesystem paths or internal field names.
Visible formulas should use math-style markup and remain readable without opening the tooltip.
Metric cards/table rows should expose formula and provenance in hover content.
Figures and summary tables need readable source footers.
Report should begin with a formal summary block.
Opening section should contain multiple report figures, not isolated dashboard cards.
Report should include inline citations or public-report labels.

benchmark_gap_notes: Bố cục bảng còn mỏng hơn đáng kể so với report v2/reference.
